listing.name: Quake II / Q2rePRO
listing.summary: Set up the Q2rePRO engine with your own Quake II rerelease installation.

restrictions.explanation: Use the publisher’s Windows nightly and the matching SDL dependency. For Linux, build from the pinned source.

steps.title: Prepare the Windows nightly
steps.instruction: On Windows x64, choose q2repro-rerelease-client_win64_x64.zip from the publisher. Use a separate writable engine folder and install the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime. For the November 12, 2026 build, extract SDL3.dll from the official SDL 3.4.14 Windows x64 runtime ZIP at https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/tag/release-3.4.14 and place it beside q2repro.exe. Check a newer build’s requirements before replacing either file.

steps.title: Use your installed Quake II rerelease
steps.instruction: Run q2repro.exe from the extracted engine folder. It can discover an installed Quake II rerelease. Keep the complete original installation, with its rerelease PAK files and game DLL, in place. To add the Windows player to your Library, select q2repro.exe and use its own folder as the working directory.

steps.title: Build the Linux player
steps.instruction: Check out commit 9619f8e20a74dec67dff0b20eb8f34a3adf926da with its submodules. Follow BUILDING.md for Meson, a C and C++ toolchain, and the Linux dependencies. Install the build with Meson so it places the native game library in baseq2 under the configured library directory. For an uninstalled build, pass the absolute Meson build directory containing baseq2/game_x86_64.so with +set libdir. Use +set basedir with the folder containing the rerelease baseq2 directory and +set homedir with a separate writable profile. Keep the source installation intact.

warnings: On Windows in rerelease mode the engine uses the Windows Saved Games folder under NightDive Studios/Quake II. Back up that shared profile before switching engines. A separate executable folder does not isolate the profile.
The publisher marks native rerelease game-DLL multiplayer as unfinished. The nightly release can replace its ZIP in place.
